name: Feast
overview: The Scriptures reveal that feasts are divinely ordained occasions for remembrance and worship, as seen in the commands to hold feasts unto the LORD throughout generations (Exodus 12:14) and at appointed times annually (Exodus 23:14). These feasts involve communal participation, including all ages and even livestock, emphasizing God's provision and deliverance, such as the Feast of Unleavened Bread commemorating Israel's exodus from Egypt (Exodus 10:9; 13:6; 23:15). Feasts also serve as times of joyful gathering and celebration, exemplified by Laban's feast in Genesis 29:22, highlighting both social and spiritual dimensions of these sacred observances.
